statusHistory.note: Per content/post-plan.md's Berlin queue (war-room slate verified 2026-08-31), byline FOODIE-9000. Dedupe check: grepped content/places/ for moebel/mobel/kotti/olfe — zero prior hits; only existing Berlin pin is so36-berlin (different address, ~170m away, no conflict). Did not trust the queue note's schedule claim at face value — verified independently. Current schedule confirmed directly against the venue's own site (moebel-olfe.de): 'Dienstag (FLINTA*-Abend) bis Samstag ab 18 Uhr' — Tuesday (FLINTA* evening) through Saturday from 18:00, closed Sunday/Monday. Corroborated independently by visitBerlin.de ('Every Tuesday at 9:30pm, FLINTA* night kicks off at Olfe with DJs and a dance floor') and flintaworld.de ('Flinta* night every Tuesday... the Flinta* Tuesdays are usually packed'). Siegessäule (siegessaeule.de), Berlin's own long-running queer press outlet, additionally confirms Tuesday as 'stadtbekannter Treff für FLTI*' and notes Thursday still runs busy/gay-leaning informally ('Schwulenschubsen... alles aus den Nähten platzt') without framing it as a formal fixed slot. Separately verified the stale claim being corrected: gay-location.com and several other listicle/directory pages still print a rigid three-day rota — 'Tuesdays for lesbians, Thursdays for gay men' (some older sources add a Friday trans night) — treating that as the venue's current identity. That framing is dated; the venue's own current site organizes the week around one official themed night (Tuesday FLINTA*, a term that itself supersedes older women-only framing) plus five other open nights with no formally announced Thursday or Friday theme, even though Thursday remains informally busy per Siegessäule. Framed the correction honestly: didn't just assert the old listicles are wrong, cited exactly which claim (the rigid lesbian/gay/trans three-day split) is outdated and against which current sources. Hero image: real, correctly-located CC BY-SA 4.0 photo of the storefront from Wikimedia Commons (2023, by user Babewyn) — first tier of the image-sourcing hierarchy, no illustration needed. All facts checked cleanly across venue's own site plus three independent current sources, so filed straight to trust: auto, status: active. External links used: moebel-olfe.de (official), visitBerlin.de, flintaworld.de, siegessaeule.de. Internal link: so36-berlin (same Kotti neighborhood, same-night FLINTA*/queer-Kreuzberg thread). New sources logged as preferred-sources.md candidates: moebel-olfe.de, flintaworld.de, siegessaeule.de.
